4000 samples: 2000 real, 2000 fake

G4: Whole sealed test set (the E-014 block)
General
Every item of the sealed block, exactly the rows E-014 reported (classes not balanced; the share is shown).
24788 samples: 16159 real, 8629 fake
Independent groups: 42 speakers
Overlap: contains every group

G5: Diagnostic: balanced within each speaker
Diagnostic
Every speaker with both real and fake recordings, with the same number of each (first in the seeded order). Inside this group a speaker's identity carries no information about the label, so it tests whether the head separates real from fake speech of the same person rather than one speaker from another.
14332 samples: 7166 real, 7166 fake
Independent groups: 42 speakers
Overlap: overlaps G1 to G4

G5: Diagnostic: image-to-image generators only
Diagnostic
CycleGAN, GauGAN and Deepfake with their own real images. These generators transform or condition on a real input, so the fakes keep the layout of real photographs; it tests whether detection holds when the fake is built from a real image rather than drawn from noise.
18047 samples: 9028 real, 9019 fake
Independent groups: 8 generator groups
Overlap: overlaps G1 to G4
